journey.name: profile deletion uncertain response
journey.description: Requires a disposable test identity and a controlled homeserver proxy; never use a personal profile. Configure the proxy to accept one profile deletion but lose its acknowledgement, retaining a redacted request counter. This is a fault-injection fixture requirement, not evidence that this journey has run. Normal SDK recovery may retry an individual request only after a confirmed authentication rejection; the app must not restart contact cleanup and profile deletion because a request has an uncertain outcome.

actions.action: Open Edit Profile and confirm deletion
Drop the acknowledgement after the server accepts the profile deletion
Verify failure options are shown and no success notification or onboarding navigation occurs
Wait through the network timeout and verify the app starts no second contact cleanup, profile deletion or sign-in
Cancel the failure dialog and verify no mutation is retried
Restart the app without choosing Retry and verify it does not automatically repeat the deletion
